author: Unity
description:
Unity sat down with indie dev Xalavier Nelson Jr., the Creative Director behind Strange Scaffold’s prodigious output – 18 full project releases in only seven years. 

He shares his system for quantifying the effort involved in bringing a game feature to life, how to identify the most impactful areas of development for your players, and talks about why creative intentionality is more important than ever for sustainable, successful games.
